title: Latent Homosexuality
paragraphs: “Well… I suppose I have no choice. Just this once, Motoyasu-sama!”
With that, Yuki-chan stopped being angry and forgave me.
“Oh my, could Motoyasu-chan be good at handling women?”
“I was simply expressing my love for the Filolials to Yuki-chan.”

I merely used the techniques I honed back when I was chasing after those pigs. At the time, I thought of it as a meaningless rite of passage, but now I can do it sincerely for the sake of the Filolials. After all, I can’t allow something like the Spirit Tortoise to interfere with Yuki-chan’s dream.
“Oh dear.”
Older Sister chuckled softly. Did I do something strange?
“Well, whatever. Anyway, we’ve defeated the Spirit Tortoise, and there’s still a month before the Phoenix’s seal is broken. It’s probably best to prepare, right?”
“That’s true.”
“But a month… Since all the hourglasses in the world have stopped, that’s a good thing, but what should we do?”
“I plan to head to the Nosferatu Great Forest as planned in two weeks. Until then, we’ll focus on steadily strengthening our forces.”
“Hmm… We should probably train soldiers other than Filolials as well. There’s a lot to do.”
“That’s the plan going forward. By the way, Yuki-chan, did you ask the breeder when the next race will be?”
I was planning to ask later, but I should confirm just in case. If the race happens to coincide with the day the Phoenix revives, we’ll need to decline beforehand.
“The next race is in three weeks. As the champion this time, I get priority to participate.”
“Oh! That means the schedule doesn’t conflict with the Phoenix’s revival, so there’s no problem.”
“I will definitely participate this time!”
I could see the fighting spirit rising in Yuki-chan’s back. That’s right! Yuki-chan is one of the great Filolials who has been chosen by the Seven Star Weapons in past loops.
“In the end, what we need to do doesn’t change much.”
“Yeah. The focus on increasing our strength remains the same.”
“As long as we can confirm that there aren’t any reincarnators or transmigrators like Takt among the forces we train, then it’s fine.”
Father and the others were nodding to each other.
“By the way, Motoyasu-kun, what kind of child was the Hakuko male who was chosen as the hero of the Seven Star Weapons?” Father asked me as part of considering future strategies.
Hmm, the Hakuko male… That guy used to pick fights with Father frequently. If I recall, he eventually became one of Father’s most loyal subordinates.
“We’ve already recruited Larsa-san, so I guess he’s the only one left…”
“A Hakuko, huh? I was told by the previous Father not to give the wrong impression.”
Yes, last time, I was scolded by Father after he misunderstood that he had been sleeping with that guy, so I kept quiet about it. That’s why I haven’t mentioned it in detail until now.
“W-What? Is there some kind of problem between me and that kid?”
Father looked at me anxiously.
“Wh-What’s going on? Motoyasu-san usually talks about bizarre things, but isn’t there an especially ominous vibe this time?”
“And yet, I have a feeling it’s going to be something incredibly trivial.”
“Oh my, everyone really understands Motoyasu-chan.”
“Well, we’ve known him for a long time now…”
“What are you all talking about?”
The panda, who had been counting money bags, turned toward us. Aren’t you focusing a little too much on counting money?
“Motoyasu-kun was trying to explain something ominous related to me when talking about the loops.”
“After all, the moment I told that story, Father started acting distant and formal with me, calling me Kitamura-san. Of course, after he believed me, he started calling me Motoyasu-kun again.”
When will he affectionately start calling me Mokkunn? The emotional distance between me and Father just isn’t closing. Someday, I hope he calls me his son.
“Motoyasu-kun, what exactly happened between me and that Hakuko guy?” Father asked me with a rather tense expression.
“Father, you slept with that Hakuko male.”
“Huh?”

Recalling the events of the previous loop, I realized I had to give a more detailed explanation. But the moment I mentioned that fact, Ren, Itsuki, and even the panda immediately distanced themselves from Father.
“Oh my…”
“I see, so that’s why he surrounds himself with women but never makes a move.”
“That explains everything.”
“It’s a misunderstanding! I’m not into men!”
Father quickly defended himself against that fact.
“But these are Motoyasu-san’s words, you know? Naofumi-san, it seems you might be a latent homosexual without even realizing it.”
“That’s right. Motoyasu is recounting knowledge from the loops. There’s no mistake.”
“Ugh… No! I’m not into men!”
“Oh my… Naofumi-chan, huh?”
Older Sister gave Father a suggestive look. Did she just come to terms with the fact that Father had slept with a Hakuko?
“Sadeena-san, you believe me, right?”
“Well, Naofumi-chan doesn’t give off that vibe right now. But… wouldn’t that be kind of fun too?”
“No, it wouldn’t be fun at all!”
Older Sister was as cheerful as ever. Perhaps that’s what makes her so popular.
“Did you enjoy a banquet of carnal pleasures? Surely Naofumi-chan could go for both men and women.”
Oh? I’ve heard that line before. That was something Older Sister said in the past.
“As long as there’s a hole, it doesn’t matter.”
“N-No! I’m not like that!”
“Good thing Gaelion isn’t here. The other day, I heard that the Dragon Emperor can produce offspring regardless of their partner’s gender.”
“I see. So, Gaelion would’ve preferred a male?”
“I want to ask why you’re suddenly bringing up Gaelion, but that’s not it! Come on, Motoyasu-kun, explain it! There’s something else, right?”
Ah, as expected of Father. I still remember how he followed up on that situation afterward.

“The Father of the first world was deceived by the Crimson Swine and couldn’t trust those who harbored feelings for him. Because of that, to reject those who were interested in him, he ended up sleeping with a Hakuko male as a bodyguard.”
Upon my clarification, Father puffed out his chest.
“See! I told you so! He was just a bodyguard. It’s not like anything physical happened!”
“Well, that Hakuko male did admire Father like a brother, and he was quite passionate, so who knows what really happened?”
Ren and Itsuki, who were trying to approach, stopped in their tracks.
“Motoyasu-kun, are you trying to label me as gay or not? Which is it?”
I felt a chilling aura of killing intent emanate from Father toward me. That’s not it! I’m just stating the facts!
“So, does that mean he was the last Seven Star Weapon candidate in that loop?”
“Do you remember his name?”
“I recall he was called Fohl or something like that.”
“Huh!?”
The panda reacted at that moment. What is it? Why are you reacting?
“Fohl… isn’t that the guy who shows up in the coliseum of this country? I’ve fought him a few times.”
“Do you know him?”
When Father asked, Older Sister also chimed in.
“Yes, if it’s a Hakuko male named Fohl, that must be the one.”
“Yeah, that’s probably him. I think he’s a slave gladiator, so he’s likely under the care of some slave trader. He’ll be expensive, but he can be bought.”
“If he’s an acquaintance, that makes things easier. Naofumi, you should take him under your protection.”
“I’d prefer if Ren, Itsuki… or Motoyasu-kun could handle that. I’m not into men.”
Father seemed to distance himself with a slightly gloomy expression. It seems I conveyed it wrong again this time.
“I see. So, it’s possible that Naofumi-san is straight, but that boy turned gay later?”
Father flinched. What is Father so afraid of?
“Don’t worry. I’ll make sure Naofumi-chan doesn’t stray from the right path.”
Older Sister consoled him with an embrace. Oh? Father and Older Sister seem to be getting quite close.
“Ah… well, I guess it can’t be helped. Larsa-san, Sadeena-san, could you investigate where we can buy that person?”
“Got it. I’m just a hired hand, after all. I’ll work for the money I’m getting.”
“If we manage to bring him in, that will complete almost all the candidates. After that, it’s just about gathering the Filolials…”
Ren crossed his arms and started thinking. Then, after glancing at Father being comforted by Older Sister, he turned to look at me.
“Hey, Motoyasu.”
“What is it?”
“If we recruit that Hakuko male, we’ll have gathered all the potential Seven Star candidates except for the deceased King of Melromarc, right?”
Upon Ren’s words, Father and Itsuki also shifted their gaze toward me. At the same time, Older Sister seemed to have a different, more resolute look in her eyes.
“No, that’s not right.”

Most of the candidates are indeed gathered. In the first world, the Claws were Filo-tan, the Hammer was Older Sister, the Staff was Trash, the Whip was Assistant, the Projectile Weapons were Stalker Pig, the axe was Green, and the Gauntlet was the Hakuko slave. In the previous loop, the hammer was Sakura-chan, the Projectile Weapons were Yuki-chan, the whip was Assistant, the Staff was Trash, and the Claw were the panda. If we exclude the Filolials from this group and focus on those who haven’t joined us yet, excluding Trash and the Hakuko slave, there’s only one person left.
“I knew it… Motoyasu, could it be that the one you’re talking about is the one you call ‘the older sister’?”
